preconditions.description: The number of destinations n is between 2 and 10^5 inclusive.
The number of Time Corridors m is between n-1 and 10^6 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and a != b for a, b, e in corridors)
preconditions.description: Each corridor connects two distinct destinations a and b, both between 1 and n inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= e <= 10**9 for a, b, e in corridors)
preconditions.description: The energy e of each corridor is between 0 and 10^9 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(set((a, b) for a, b, e in corridors)) == m
preconditions.description: All pairs of destinations in the corridors are unique.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines is equal to the number of corridors not in the minimum spanning tree.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= e_max <= 10**9 for e_max in output_lines)
postconditions.description: Each E_max(c_i) is between 0 and 10^9 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(e_max <= e for e_max, (_, _, e) in zip(output_lines, corridors))
postconditions.description: Each E_max(c_i) is less than or equal to the original energy of the corresponding corridor.
